charts.title: HIP 9618 b: orbits around HIP 9618
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 9618's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 9618 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Osborn et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.523.3069O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname OSBORN_ET_AL__2023): P 20.772907 d

charts.title: HIP 9618 b: its transit
charts.description: HIP 9618 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (70, 71, 85) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 306263608, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 20-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 20-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
